domain.text: Per-request cost attribution across model switches, including legacy segments and lower-bound pricing.

impressions.text: The worker addressed the legacy-segment pricing defect by attributing requests by model or switch time, preserving earlier totals, and using lower-bound pricing when counts did not reconcile.
Reported strengths include targeted regression coverage for legacy caches, model switches, repeated models, and inconsistent usage, plus a full local test suite of 1,087 passing tests.
A disk-full condition initially blocked verification; after cleanup, the worker reported all required local checks passing and CI green.
The first CI push was reported red because of an incorrect fragment filename/header; the worker corrected it and reported green CI on the final head.
The orchestrator reported that live `grade 124` succeeded on the patched build, and the pull request was merged.
